#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

class FFT {
private:
    static const int MAX_K = 21;
    static const int MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K;
    static double wR[MAX_N];
    static double wI[MAX_N];
    static double aR[MAX_N];
    static double aI[MAX_N];
    static int n, k, lastK;
    static int rev[MAX_N];

    static void transform(bool inverse) {
        if (lastK != k) {
            lastK = k;
            rev[0] = 0;
            for (int i = 1, g = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if ((i & (i - 1)) == 0) g++;
                rev[i] = rev[i ^ (1 << g)] ^ (1 << (k - 1 - g));
            }
            wR[1] = 1;
            wI[1] = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < k - 1; t++) {
                double angle = M_PI / n * (1 << (k - 1 - t));
                double cosVal = cos(angle);
                double sinVal = sin(angle);
                int p2 = 1 << t;
                int p3 = p2 << 1;
                for (int j = p2, idx = p3; j < p3; j++, idx += 2) {
                    wR[idx] = wR[j];
                    wI[idx] = wI[j];
                    wR[idx + 1] = wR[j] * cosVal - wI[j] * sinVal;
                    wI[idx + 1] = wR[j] * sinVal + wI[j] * cosVal;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int r = rev[i];
            if (i < r) {
                double tmp = aR[i];
                aR[i] = aR[r];
                aR[r] = tmp;
                tmp = aI[i];
                aI[i] = aI[r];
                aI[r] = tmp;
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) aI[i] = -aI[i];
        }
        for (int len = 1; len < n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                int wIdx = len;
                for (int j = i + len, it = 0; it < len; it++, i++, j++) {
                    double tr = aR[j] * wR[wIdx] - aI[j] * wI[wIdx];
                    double ti = aR[j] * wI[wIdx] + aI[j] * wR[wIdx];
                    wIdx++;
                    aR[j] = aR[i] - tr;
                    aI[j] = aI[i] - ti;
                    aR[i] += tr;
                    aI[i] += ti;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static vector<long long> multiply(vector<long long>& x, vector<long long>& y) {
        int lenX = x.size(), lenY = y.size();
        for (k = 0, n = 1; n < lenX + lenY - 1; n <<= 1, k++) {}
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            aR[i] = (i < lenX) ? x[i] : 0;
            aI[i] = (i < lenY) ? y[i] : 0;
        }
        transform(false);
        aR[n] = aR[0];
        aI[n] = aI[0];
        double scale = -1.0 / n / 4.0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - i; i++) {
            double r1 = aR[i] * aR[i] - aI[i] * aI[i];
            double i1 = 2 * aR[i] * aI[i];
            double r2 = aR[n - i] * aR[n - i] - aI[n - i] * aI[n - i];
            double i2 = -2 * aR[n - i] * aI[n - i];
            double nr = -i1 + i2;
            double ni = r1 - r2;
            aR[i] = nr * scale;
            aI[i] = ni * scale;
            aR[n - i] = aR[i];
            aI[n - i] = -aI[i];
        }
        transform(true);
        vector<long long> res(lenX + lenY - 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < res.size(); i++) {
            res[i] = llround(aR[i]) % MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }

public:
    static vector<long long> multiplyPrecise(vector<long long>& x, vector<long long>& y) {
        long long sqrtMod = (long long)sqrt(MOD);
        vector<long long> xl(x.size()), xh(x.size());
        vector<long long> yl(y.size()), yh(y.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
            xl[i] = x[i] % sqrtMod;
            xh[i] = x[i] / sqrtMod;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < y.size(); i++) {
            yl[i] = y[i] % sqrtMod;
            yh[i] = y[i] / sqrtMod;
        }
        vector<long long> r11 = multiply(xl, yl);
        vector<long long> r12 = multiply(xl, yh);
        vector<long long> r21 = multiply(xh, yl);
        vector<long long> r22 = multiply(xh, yh);
        vector<long long> res(r11.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < res.size(); i++) {
            long long term1 = (sqrtMod * sqrtMod % MOD) * r22[i] % MOD;
            long long term2 = sqrtMod * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD) % MOD;
            res[i] = (term1 + term2 + r11[i]) % MOD;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

// Static member definitions
double FFT::wR[1 << 21];
double FFT::wI[1 << 21];
double FFT::aR[1 << 21];
double FFT::aI[1 << 21];
int FFT::n, FFT::k, FFT::lastK = -1;
int FFT::rev[1 << 21];

vector<long long> power(vector<long long>& base, long long exponent) {
    if (exponent == 1) return base;
    if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
        return FFT::multiplyPrecise(base, power(base, exponent - 1));
    }
    vector<long long> half = power(base, exponent >> 1);
    return FFT::multiplyPrecise(half, half);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss1(line);
    int n, k;
    ss1 >> n >> k;

    vector<long long> base(10, 0);
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss2(line);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int num;
        ss2 >> num;
        base[num] = 1;
    }

    vector<long long> result = power(base, n / 2);
    long long sum = 0;
    for (long long x : result) {
        sum = (sum + x * x % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    cout << sum << endl;

    return 0;
}
